local UnityDebug = CS.UnityEngine.Debug

local Logger = {}
local LoggerInstance = {}
LoggerInstance.__index = LoggerInstance

local function normalizeTag(tag)
    if tag == nil or tag == "" then
        return "worldplay"
    end
    return tostring(tag)
end

local function formatMessage(tag, ...)
    local parts = { "[" .. tag .. "]" }
    for index = 1, select("#", ...) do
        local value = select(index, ...)
        parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(value)
    end
    return table.concat(parts, " ")
end

function LoggerInstance:info(...)
    UnityDebug.Log(formatMessage(self.tag, ...))
end

function LoggerInstance:warn(...)
    UnityDebug.LogWarning(formatMessage(self.tag, ...))
end

function LoggerInstance:error(...)
    UnityDebug.LogError(formatMessage(self.tag, ...))
end

function LoggerInstance:warnOnce(key, ...)
    if key == nil then
        self:warn(...)
        return true
    end

    local normalizedKey = tostring(key)
    if self.warnedKeys[normalizedKey] == true then
        return false
    end
    self.warnedKeys[normalizedKey] = true
    self:warn(...)
    return true
end

function Logger.create(tag)
    return setmetatable({
        tag = normalizeTag(tag),
        warnedKeys = {},
    }, LoggerInstance)
end

return Logger

local NodeLookup = {}

NodeLookup.Reason = {
    InvalidRoot = "node-lookup-invalid-root",
    InvalidPath = "node-lookup-invalid-path",
    NotFound = "node-lookup-not-found",
}

local function resolveTransform(value)
    if value == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.gameObject.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    local childCount
    ok, childCount = pcall(function()
        return value.childCount
    end)
    if ok and childCount ~= nil then
        return value
    end
    return nil
end

local function resolveGameObject(transform)
    if transform == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, gameObject = pcall(function()
        return transform.gameObject
    end)
    if ok then
        return gameObject
    end
    return nil
end

local function isValidPathSegment(segment)
    if type(segment) ~= "string" or segment == "" or segment == "." or segment == ".." then
        return false
    end
    if segment:find("/", 1, true) ~= nil or segment:find("\\", 1, true) ~= nil then
        return false
    end
    for index = 1, #segment do
        local byte = segment:byte(index)
        if byte <= 31 or byte == 127 then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

local function isValidNodePath(path)
    if type(path) ~= "string" then
        return false
    end
    if path == "" then
        return true
    end
    if path:sub(1, 1) == "/" or path:sub(-1) == "/" then
        return false
    end
    if path:find("//", 1, true) ~= nil then
        return false
    end

    for segment in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
        if not isValidPathSegment(segment) then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

-- Accept one leading slash. When an exact lookup misses, retry once without
-- the GLB root segment so inspected full paths survive Runtime root renames.
local function stripOneLeadingSlash(path)
    if type(path) ~= "string" then
        return path
    end
    if path:sub(1, 1) == "/" then
        return path:sub(2)
    end
    return path
end

local function stripGlbRootSegment(path)
    local separatorIndex = path:find("/", 1, true)
    if separatorIndex == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return path:sub(separatorIndex + 1)
end

local function normalizeNodePath(nodePath)
    local normalizedPath = stripOneLeadingSlash(nodePath)
    if not isValidNodePath(normalizedPath) then
        return nil
    end
    return normalizedPath
end

local function findIndexedValue(valueByPath, normalizedPath)
    local value = valueByPath[normalizedPath]
    if value ~= nil then
        return value
    end

    local rootRelativePath = stripGlbRootSegment(normalizedPath)
    if rootRelativePath == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return valueByPath[rootRelativePath]
end

local function tryFindTransform(rootTransform, path)
    local ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return rootTransform:Find(path)
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    return transform
end

function NodeLookup.createIndex(root)
    local rootTransform = resolveTransform(root)
    local rootGameObject = resolveGameObject(rootTransform)
    if rootTransform == nil or rootGameObject == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local index = {
        transformByPath = { [""] = rootTransform },
        gameObjectByPath = { [""] = rootGameObject },
    }
    local pending = { { path = "", transform = rootTransform } }

    while #pending > 0 do
        local current = table.remove(pending)
        local ok, childCount = pcall(function()
            return current.transform.childCount
        end)
        if not ok or type(childCount) ~= "number" then
            return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
        end

        for childIndex = 0, childCount - 1 do
            local childOk, child = pcall(function()
                return current.transform:GetChild(childIndex)
            end)
            if not childOk or child == nil then
                return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
            end

            local nameOk, childName = pcall(function()
                return child.name
            end)
            if not nameOk then
                return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
            end

            if isValidPathSegment(childName) then
                local childPath = current.path == "" and childName or current.path .. "/" .. childName
                if index.transformByPath[childPath] == nil then
                    local childGameObject = resolveGameObject(child)
                    if childGameObject == nil then
                        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
                    end
                    index.transformByPath[childPath] = child
                    index.gameObjectByPath[childPath] = childGameObject
                    pending[#pending + 1] = { path = childPath, transform = child }
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return index
end

function NodeLookup.findTransform(root, nodePath)
    local rootTransform = resolveTransform(root)
    if rootTransform == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local normalizedPath = normalizeNodePath(nodePath)
    if normalizedPath == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidPath
    end
    if normalizedPath == "" then
        return rootTransform
    end

    local transform, reason = tryFindTransform(rootTransform, normalizedPath)
    if reason ~= nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    if transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    local rootRelativePath = stripGlbRootSegment(normalizedPath)
    if rootRelativePath == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.NotFound
    end

    transform, reason = tryFindTransform(rootTransform, rootRelativePath)
    if reason ~= nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    if transform == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.NotFound
    end
    return transform
end

function NodeLookup.findIndexedTransform(index, nodePath)
    if type(index) ~= "table" or type(index.transformByPath) ~= "table" then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local normalizedPath = normalizeNodePath(nodePath)
    if normalizedPath == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidPath
    end

    local transform = findIndexedValue(index.transformByPath, normalizedPath)
    if transform == nil or resolveGameObject(transform) == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.NotFound
    end
    return transform
end

function NodeLookup.findGameObject(root, nodePath)
    local transform, reason = NodeLookup.findTransform(root, nodePath)
    if transform == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    local ok, gameObject = pcall(function()
        return transform.gameObject
    end)
    if not ok or gameObject == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    return gameObject
end

function NodeLookup.findIndexedGameObject(index, nodePath)
    if type(index) ~= "table" or type(index.gameObjectByPath) ~= "table" then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local normalizedPath = normalizeNodePath(nodePath)
    if normalizedPath == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.InvalidPath
    end

    local gameObject = findIndexedValue(index.gameObjectByPath, normalizedPath)
    if gameObject == nil or resolveTransform(gameObject) == nil then
        return nil, NodeLookup.Reason.NotFound
    end
    return gameObject
end

return NodeLookup

official/core/runtime_scope.lua.content:
local NodeLookup = require("official.core.node_lookup")

local RuntimeScope = {}

RuntimeScope.Reason = {
    InvalidRoot = "runtime-resource-scope-invalid-root",
    Unavailable = "runtime-resource-scope-unavailable",
    InvalidScriptId = "runtime-script-invalid-id",
    ScriptNotReady = "runtime-script-not-ready",
    ScriptQueryFailed = "runtime-script-query-failed",
    RuntimeHostUnbound = "runtime-host-unbound",
    RuntimeHostScriptNotReady = "runtime-host-script-not-ready",
    RuntimeHostScriptQueryFailed = "runtime-host-script-query-failed",
}

local Scope = {}
Scope.__index = Scope

local RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME = "runtime-builtin/runtime-host-root-bootstrap.lua"
local RUNTIME_RESOURCE_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME = "runtime-builtin/runtime-resource-root-bootstrap.lua"

local scopeByGameObject = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local scopeByResourceRoot = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function resolveGameObject(value)
    if value == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, gameObject = pcall(function()
        return value.gameObject
    end)
    if ok and gameObject ~= nil then
        return gameObject
    end
    return value
end

local function resolveTransform(value)
    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(value)
    if gameObject == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return gameObject.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.transform
    end)
    if ok then
        return transform
    end
    return nil
end

local function bindGameObject(scope, gameObject)
    if gameObject == nil then
        return
    end

    local previousScope = scopeByGameObject[gameObject]
    if previousScope ~= nil and previousScope ~= scope then
        previousScope.members[gameObject] = nil
    end
    scopeByGameObject[gameObject] = scope
    scope.members[gameObject] = true
end

local function normalizeScriptId(scriptId)
    if type(scriptId) ~= "string" or scriptId == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local runtimeScriptId = string.gsub(scriptId, "/", "_")
    return runtimeScriptId
end

local function hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, referenceName)
    local runtimeScriptId = normalizeScriptId(referenceName)
    if runtimeScriptId == nil then
        return false
    end

    local ok, component = pcall(function()
        return gameObject:GetDouyinScript(runtimeScriptId)
    end)
    return ok and component ~= nil
end

local function isNestedScopeRoot(scope, gameObject)
    if gameObject == scope.resourceRoot then
        return false
    end
    return hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, RUNTIME_RESOURCE_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME)
        or hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME)
end

local function collectSubtreeGameObjects(scope, root, stopAtScopeBoundaries)
    local rootTransform = resolveTransform(root)
    if rootTransform == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local gameObjects = {}
    local pending = { rootTransform }
    while #pending > 0 do
        local transform = table.remove(pending)
        local gameObject = resolveGameObject(transform)
        if gameObject == nil then
            return nil
        end

        if not stopAtScopeBoundaries or not isNestedScopeRoot(scope, gameObject) then
            gameObjects[#gameObjects + 1] = gameObject

            local ok, childCount = pcall(function()
                return transform.childCount
            end)
            if not ok or type(childCount) ~= "number" then
                return nil
            end
            for index = 0, childCount - 1 do
                local childOk, child = pcall(function()
                    return transform:GetChild(index)
                end)
                if not childOk or child == nil then
                    return nil
                end
                pending[#pending + 1] = child
            end
        end
    end
    return gameObjects
end

local function bindSubtree(scope, root, stopAtScopeBoundaries)
    local gameObjects = collectSubtreeGameObjects(scope, root, stopAtScopeBoundaries)
    if gameObjects == nil then
        return false
    end
    for _, gameObject in ipairs(gameObjects) do
        bindGameObject(scope, gameObject)
    end
    return true
end

local function findNearestMarker(value, referenceName)
    local transform = resolveTransform(value)
    while transform ~= nil do
        local gameObject = transform.gameObject
        if hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, referenceName) then
            return gameObject
        end
        transform = transform.parent
    end
    return nil
end

local function findNearestScopeRoot(value)
    local transform = resolveTransform(value)
    while transform ~= nil do
        local gameObject = transform.gameObject
        if hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, RUNTIME_RESOURCE_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME) then
            return gameObject, false
        end
        if hasBuiltinMarker(gameObject, RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME) then
            return gameObject, true
        end
        transform = transform.parent
    end
    return nil, false
end

local function queryScript(root, scriptId, queryFailedReason, notReadyReason)
    if root == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local runtimeScriptId = normalizeScriptId(scriptId)
    if runtimeScriptId == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidScriptId
    end

    local ok, script = pcall(function()
        local component = root:GetDouyinScript(runtimeScriptId)
        return component ~= nil and component.script or nil
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil, queryFailedReason
    end
    if script == nil then
        return nil, notReadyReason
    end
    return script
end

local function createDirectScope(resourceRoot, runtimeHostRoot, isRuntimeHostRoot)
    local existingScope = scopeByResourceRoot[resourceRoot]
    if existingScope ~= nil
        and existingScope.runtimeHostRoot == runtimeHostRoot
        and existingScope.isRuntimeHostRoot == isRuntimeHostRoot then
        bindGameObject(existingScope, resourceRoot)
        return existingScope
    end

    local nodeIndex = NodeLookup.createIndex(resourceRoot)
    if nodeIndex == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    RuntimeScope.unregister(resourceRoot)
    local scope = setmetatable({
        isRuntimeHostRoot = isRuntimeHostRoot,
        resourceRoot = resourceRoot,
        runtimeHostRoot = runtimeHostRoot,
        nodeIndex = nodeIndex,
        members = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    }, Scope)
    if isRuntimeHostRoot then
        bindGameObject(scope, resourceRoot)
    elseif not bindSubtree(scope, resourceRoot, true) then
        scope.nodeIndex = nil
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    scopeByResourceRoot[resourceRoot] = scope
    return scope
end

function Scope:GetResourceRoot()
    return self.resourceRoot
end

function Scope:GetRuntimeHostRoot()
    if self.runtimeHostRoot ~= nil then
        return self.runtimeHostRoot
    end
    return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.RuntimeHostUnbound
end

function Scope:GetScript(scriptId)
    return queryScript(
        self.resourceRoot,
        scriptId,
        RuntimeScope.Reason.ScriptQueryFailed,
        RuntimeScope.Reason.ScriptNotReady
    )
end

function Scope:FindTransform(nodePath)
    return NodeLookup.findIndexedTransform(self.nodeIndex, nodePath)
end

function Scope:FindGameObject(nodePath)
    return NodeLookup.findIndexedGameObject(self.nodeIndex, nodePath)
end

function Scope:GetRuntimeHostScript(scriptId)
    local runtimeHostRoot, reason = self:GetRuntimeHostRoot()
    if runtimeHostRoot == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end

    return queryScript(
        runtimeHostRoot,
        scriptId or "runtime-host.lua",
        RuntimeScope.Reason.RuntimeHostScriptQueryFailed,
        RuntimeScope.Reason.RuntimeHostScriptNotReady
    )
end

function RuntimeScope.registerHostRoot(resourceRoot)
    local rootGameObject = resolveGameObject(resourceRoot)
    if rootGameObject == nil or resolveTransform(rootGameObject) == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    return createDirectScope(rootGameObject, rootGameObject, true)
end

function RuntimeScope.registerResourceRoot(resourceRoot)
    local rootGameObject = resolveGameObject(resourceRoot)
    local rootTransform = resolveTransform(rootGameObject)
    if rootGameObject == nil or rootTransform == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end

    local runtimeHostRoot = findNearestMarker(rootTransform.parent, RUNTIME_HOST_ROOT_BOOTSTRAP_REFERENCE_NAME)
    return createDirectScope(rootGameObject, runtimeHostRoot, false)
end

function RuntimeScope.unregister(resourceRoot, expectedScope)
    local rootGameObject = resolveGameObject(resourceRoot)
    local scope = rootGameObject ~= nil and scopeByResourceRoot[rootGameObject] or nil
    if scope == nil or (expectedScope ~= nil and scope ~= expectedScope) then
        return false
    end

    for gameObject in pairs(scope.members) do
        if scopeByGameObject[gameObject] == scope then
            scopeByGameObject[gameObject] = nil
        end
    end
    scope.nodeIndex = nil
    scopeByResourceRoot[rootGameObject] = nil
    return true
end

function RuntimeScope.discover(value)
    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(value)
    if gameObject == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.Unavailable
    end

    local resourceRoot, isRuntimeHostRoot = findNearestScopeRoot(gameObject)
    local scope = nil
    if isRuntimeHostRoot then
        scope = RuntimeScope.registerHostRoot(resourceRoot)
    elseif resourceRoot ~= nil then
        scope = RuntimeScope.registerResourceRoot(resourceRoot)
    end

    if scope == nil then
        return nil, RuntimeScope.Reason.Unavailable
    end
    bindGameObject(scope, gameObject)
    return scope
end

function RuntimeScope.from(value)
    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(value)
    local scope = gameObject ~= nil and scopeByGameObject[gameObject] or nil
    if scope ~= nil then
        return scope
    end
    return RuntimeScope.discover(gameObject)
end

function RuntimeScope.resolveResourceRoot(value)
    local scope, reason = RuntimeScope.from(value)
    if scope == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end
    return scope:GetResourceRoot()
end

function RuntimeScope.bindGameObject(scope, value)
    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(value)
    if scope == nil or scope.resourceRoot == nil or gameObject == nil then
        return false, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    bindGameObject(scope, gameObject)
    return true
end

function RuntimeScope.bindSubtree(scope, value)
    if scope == nil or scope.resourceRoot == nil or not bindSubtree(scope, value) then
        return false, RuntimeScope.Reason.InvalidRoot
    end
    return true
end

return RuntimeScope

local Collider = CS.UnityEngine.Collider
local Vector3 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3

local Containment = {}

Containment.Reason = {
    InvalidOptions = "containment-invalid-options",
    InvalidSubject = "containment-invalid-subject",
    InvalidContainer = "containment-invalid-container",
    InvalidInset = "containment-invalid-inset",
    InvalidEpsilon = "containment-invalid-epsilon",
    QueryFailed = "containment-query-failed",
    NoSubjectCollider = "containment-no-subject-collider",
    NoContainerCollider = "containment-no-container-collider",
    CollapsedContainer = "containment-collapsed-container",
    EvaluationFailed = "containment-evaluation-failed",
}

local function isFiniteNumber(value)
    return type(value) == "number"
        and value == value
        and value ~= math.huge
        and value ~= -math.huge
end

local function resolveTransform(value)
    if value == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.gameObject.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return transform
    end

    ok, transform = pcall(function()
        local _ = value.childCount
        return value
    end)
    if ok then
        return transform
    end
    return nil
end

local function readInset(value)
    if value == nil then
        return { x = 0, y = 0, z = 0 }
    end
    if isFiniteNumber(value) and value >= 0 then
        return { x = value, y = value, z = value }
    end

    local ok, x, y, z = pcall(function()
        return value.x, value.y, value.z
    end)
    if not ok
        or not isFiniteNumber(x) or x < 0
        or not isFiniteNumber(y) or y < 0
        or not isFiniteNumber(z) or z < 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return { x = x, y = y, z = z }
end

local function queryColliders(rootTransform, includeInactive)
    local gameObject = rootTransform.gameObject
    local colliders = gameObject:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(Collider), includeInactive)
    local result = {}
    if colliders ~= nil then
        for index = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do
            local collider = colliders[index]
            if collider ~= nil then
                result[#result + 1] = collider
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end

local function includeCollider(collider, excluded)
    return (excluded == nil or excluded[collider] ~= true)
        and collider.enabled == true
        and collider.isTrigger ~= true
end

local function appendPoint(bounds, point)
    if not isFiniteNumber(point.x)
        or not isFiniteNumber(point.y)
        or not isFiniteNumber(point.z) then
        error("containment point is not finite")
    end

    if bounds.empty then
        bounds.minX, bounds.maxX = point.x, point.x
        bounds.minY, bounds.maxY = point.y, point.y
        bounds.minZ, bounds.maxZ = point.z, point.z
        bounds.empty = false
        return
    end

    bounds.minX = math.min(bounds.minX, point.x)
    bounds.maxX = math.max(bounds.maxX, point.x)
    bounds.minY = math.min(bounds.minY, point.y)
    bounds.maxY = math.max(bounds.maxY, point.y)
    bounds.minZ = math.min(bounds.minZ, point.z)
    bounds.maxZ = math.max(bounds.maxZ, point.z)
end

local function appendLocalBoundsCorners(bounds, center, size, sourceTransform, referenceTransform)
    local halfX = size.x * 0.5
    local halfY = size.y * 0.5
    local halfZ = size.z * 0.5

    for xSign = -1, 1, 2 do
        for ySign = -1, 1, 2 do
            for zSign = -1, 1, 2 do
                local sourcePoint = Vector3(
                    center.x + halfX * xSign,
                    center.y + halfY * ySign,
                    center.z + halfZ * zSign
                )
                local worldPoint = sourceTransform:TransformPoint(sourcePoint)
                appendPoint(bounds, referenceTransform:InverseTransformPoint(worldPoint))
            end
        end
    end
end

local function appendWorldBoundsCorners(bounds, worldBounds, referenceTransform)
    local min = worldBounds.min
    local max = worldBounds.max
    for xIndex = 0, 1 do
        for yIndex = 0, 1 do
            for zIndex = 0, 1 do
                local worldPoint = Vector3(
                    xIndex == 0 and min.x or max.x,
                    yIndex == 0 and min.y or max.y,
                    zIndex == 0 and min.z or max.z
                )
                appendPoint(bounds, referenceTransform:InverseTransformPoint(worldPoint))
            end
        end
    end
end

local function appendColliderCorners(bounds, collider, referenceTransform)
    local localBoundsOk, center, size = pcall(function()
        return collider.center, collider.size
    end)
    if localBoundsOk and center ~= nil and size ~= nil then
        appendLocalBoundsCorners(bounds, center, size, collider.transform, referenceTransform)
        return
    end

    local meshBoundsOk, meshCenter, meshSize = pcall(function()
        local mesh = collider.sharedMesh
        if mesh == nil then return nil, nil end
        return mesh.bounds.center, mesh.bounds.size
    end)
    if meshBoundsOk and meshCenter ~= nil and meshSize ~= nil then
        appendLocalBoundsCorners(bounds, meshCenter, meshSize, collider.transform, referenceTransform)
        return
    end

    appendWorldBoundsCorners(bounds, collider.bounds, referenceTransform)
end

local function collectBounds(colliders, excluded, referenceTransform, missingReason)
    local bounds = { empty = true }
    local colliderCount = 0
    for _, collider in ipairs(colliders) do
        if includeCollider(collider, excluded) then
            appendColliderCorners(bounds, collider, referenceTransform)
            colliderCount = colliderCount + 1
        end
    end
    if colliderCount == 0 then
        return nil, missingReason
    end
    return bounds
end

local function toPublicBounds(bounds)
    return {
        min = Vector3(bounds.minX, bounds.minY, bounds.minZ),
        max = Vector3(bounds.maxX, bounds.maxY, bounds.maxZ),
    }
end

local function findOutside(subject, container)
    if subject.minX < container.minX then
        return "x", "min", container.minX - subject.minX
    end
    if subject.maxX > container.maxX then
        return "x", "max", subject.maxX - container.maxX
    end
    if subject.minY < container.minY then
        return "y", "min", container.minY - subject.minY
    end
    if subject.maxY > container.maxY then
        return "y", "max", subject.maxY - container.maxY
    end
    if subject.minZ < container.minZ then
        return "z", "min", container.minZ - subject.minZ
    end
    if subject.maxZ > container.maxZ then
        return "z", "max", subject.maxZ - container.maxZ
    end
    return nil
end

local function evaluate(checker)
    local subjectBounds, subjectReason = collectBounds(
        checker.subjectColliders,
        nil,
        checker.containerTransform,
        Containment.Reason.NoSubjectCollider
    )
    if subjectBounds == nil then
        return nil, subjectReason
    end

    local containerBounds, containerReason = collectBounds(
        checker.containerColliders,
        checker.subjectColliderSet,
        checker.containerTransform,
        Containment.Reason.NoContainerCollider
    )
    if containerBounds == nil then
        return nil, containerReason
    end

    local minInset = checker.containerMinInset
    local maxInset = checker.containerMaxInset
    local epsilon = checker.epsilon
    local effectiveContainer = {
        minX = containerBounds.minX + minInset.x - epsilon,
        maxX = containerBounds.maxX - maxInset.x + epsilon,
        minY = containerBounds.minY + minInset.y - epsilon,
        maxY = containerBounds.maxY - maxInset.y + epsilon,
        minZ = containerBounds.minZ + minInset.z - epsilon,
        maxZ = containerBounds.maxZ - maxInset.z + epsilon,
    }
    if effectiveContainer.minX >= effectiveContainer.maxX
        or effectiveContainer.minY >= effectiveContainer.maxY
        or effectiveContainer.minZ >= effectiveContainer.maxZ then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.CollapsedContainer
    end

    local outsideAxis, outsideSide, outsideDistance = findOutside(subjectBounds, effectiveContainer)
    local details = {
        subjectBounds = toPublicBounds(subjectBounds),
        containerBounds = toPublicBounds(containerBounds),
        effectiveContainerBounds = toPublicBounds(effectiveContainer),
        outsideAxis = outsideAxis,
        outsideSide = outsideSide,
        outsideDistance = outsideDistance,
    }
    return outsideAxis == nil, details
end

local Checker = {}
Checker.__index = Checker

function Checker:check()
    local ok, contained, details = pcall(evaluate, self)
    if not ok then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.EvaluationFailed
    end
    return contained, details
end

function Containment.create(options)
    if type(options) ~= "table" then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidOptions
    end
    if options.includeInactive ~= nil and type(options.includeInactive) ~= "boolean" then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidOptions
    end

    local subjectTransform = resolveTransform(options.subjectRoot)
    if subjectTransform == nil then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidSubject
    end
    local containerTransform = resolveTransform(options.containerRoot)
    if containerTransform == nil then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidContainer
    end

    local containerInset = readInset(options.containerInset)
    if containerInset == nil then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidInset
    end
    local containerMinInset = options.containerMinInset == nil
        and containerInset
        or readInset(options.containerMinInset)
    local containerMaxInset = options.containerMaxInset == nil
        and containerInset
        or readInset(options.containerMaxInset)
    if containerMinInset == nil or containerMaxInset == nil then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidInset
    end
    local epsilon = options.epsilon
    if epsilon == nil then
        epsilon = 0.001
    end
    if not isFiniteNumber(epsilon) or epsilon < 0 then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.InvalidEpsilon
    end

    local ok, subjectColliders, containerColliders = pcall(function()
        return queryColliders(subjectTransform, options.includeInactive == true),
            queryColliders(containerTransform, options.includeInactive == true)
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil, Containment.Reason.QueryFailed
    end

    local subjectColliderSet = {}
    for _, collider in ipairs(subjectColliders) do
        subjectColliderSet[collider] = true
    end

    return setmetatable({
        containerTransform = containerTransform,
        subjectColliders = subjectColliders,
        subjectColliderSet = subjectColliderSet,
        containerColliders = containerColliders,
        containerMinInset = containerMinInset,
        containerMaxInset = containerMaxInset,
        epsilon = epsilon,
    }, Checker)
end

return Containment

local BoxCollider = CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider
local Vector3 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3

local Trigger = {}

Trigger.Reason = {
    InvalidTarget = "trigger-invalid-target",
    QueryFailed = "trigger-query-failed",
    NotFound = "trigger-not-found",
    Ambiguous = "trigger-ambiguous",
    InvalidScale = "trigger-invalid-scale",
    ScaleFailed = "trigger-scale-failed",
}

local function resolveGameObject(value)
    if value == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, gameObject = pcall(function()
        return value.gameObject
    end)
    if ok and gameObject ~= nil then
        return gameObject
    end

    local transform
    ok, transform = pcall(function()
        return value.transform
    end)
    if ok and transform ~= nil then
        return value
    end
    return nil
end

function Trigger.findBoxCollider(value)
    local gameObject = resolveGameObject(value)
    if gameObject == nil then
        return nil, Trigger.Reason.InvalidTarget
    end

    local ok, collider, reason = pcall(function()
        local colliders = gameObject:GetComponents(typeof(BoxCollider))
        local found = nil
        if colliders ~= nil then
            for index = 0, colliders.Length - 1 do
                local candidate = colliders[index]
                if candidate ~= nil and candidate.isTrigger == true then
                    if found ~= nil then
                        return nil, Trigger.Reason.Ambiguous
                    end
                    found = candidate
                end
            end
        end

        if found == nil then
            return nil, Trigger.Reason.NotFound
        end
        return found
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil, Trigger.Reason.QueryFailed
    end
    return collider, reason
end

function Trigger.applyRangeScale(value, scale)
    if type(scale) ~= "number" or scale ~= scale or scale == math.huge or scale == -math.huge then
        return nil, Trigger.Reason.InvalidScale
    end

    local collider, reason = Trigger.findBoxCollider(value)
    if collider == nil then
        return nil, reason
    end

    local ok = pcall(function()
        local size = collider.size
        collider.size = Vector3(
            size.x * scale,
            size.y * scale,
            size.z * scale
        )
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil, Trigger.Reason.ScaleFailed
    end
    return collider
end

return Trigger

official/ui/animation.lua.content:
-- Runtime UI tween 动画 ModuleScript。
-- 每个 ui.lua 调用一次 Animation.create()，避免不同 UI 共享 tween 和节点缓存。

local UnityEngine = CS.UnityEngine
local CanvasGroupType = typeof(CS.UnityEngine.CanvasGroup)
local RectTransformType = typeof(CS.UnityEngine.RectTransform)
local Logger = require("official.core.logger")

local Animation = {}

function Animation.create(loggerTag)
    local animationLogger = Logger.create(loggerTag or "runtime-ui-animation")
    local Anim = {}

    local activeTweens = {}
    local origPositions = {}
    local origScales = {}

    local Ease = {
        linear = function(t) return t end,
        outQuad = function(t) return 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t) end,
        outCubic = function(t)
            local u = 1 - t
            return 1 - u * u * u
        end,
        outBack = function(t)
            local c1, c3 = 1.70158, 2.70158
            local u = t - 1
            return 1 + c3 * u * u * u + c1 * u * u
        end,
    }

    -- 同一 (target, channel) 只保留一条 tween：注册前清掉旧的
    local function removeChannel(target, channel)
        if target == nil or channel == nil then
            return
        end
        local i = 1
        while i <= #activeTweens do
            local tw = activeTweens[i]
            if tw.target == target and tw.channel == channel then
                table.remove(activeTweens, i)
            else
                i = i + 1
            end
        end
    end

    local function addTween(tw)
        tw.elapsed = 0
        removeChannel(tw.target, tw.channel)
        activeTweens[#activeTweens + 1] = tw
    end

    -- 由 ui.lua 的 Update() 每帧调用；dt 传 unscaledDeltaTime（不受 timeScale / 暂停影响）
    function Anim.tick(dt)
        dt = dt or UnityEngine.Time.unscaledDeltaTime
        local i = 1
        while i <= #activeTweens do
            local tw = activeTweens[i]
            tw.elapsed = tw.elapsed + dt
            local finished = false   -- true => 移除该 tween
            local completed = false  -- true => 自然播完，触发 onComplete
            if tw.loopFn then
                local wait = tw.delay or 0
                if tw.elapsed >= wait then
                    local ok, ret = pcall(tw.loopFn, tw.elapsed - wait)
                    if not ok or ret == false then
                        finished = true   -- 显式 return false 或目标销毁 → 自止
                    end
                end
            else
                local t = (tw.elapsed - (tw.delay or 0)) / tw.duration
                if t >= 1 then
                    pcall(tw.apply, 1)    -- 强制落精确终态
                    finished = true
                    completed = true
                elseif t > 0 then
                    if not pcall(tw.apply, (tw.ease or Ease.outQuad)(t)) then
                        finished = true   -- 写属性抛错 = 目标已销毁，当帧回收
                    end
                end
            end
            if finished then
                table.remove(activeTweens, i)   -- 先移除再触发 onComplete，避免链式 addTween 与自身同通道冲突
                if completed and tw.onComplete then
                    pcall(tw.onComplete)
                end
            else
                i = i + 1
            end
        end
    end

    local function getCanvasGroup(go)
        local cg = go:GetComponent(CanvasGroupType)
        if cg == nil then
            cg = go:AddComponent(CanvasGroupType)
        end
        return cg
    end

    local function getOrigPos(go)
        local rec = origPositions[go]
        if rec == nil then
            local rect = go:GetComponent(RectTransformType)
            if rect == nil then
                return nil
            end
            local p = rect.anchoredPosition
            rec = { rect = rect, x = p.x, y = p.y }
            origPositions[go] = rec
        end
        return rec
    end

    local function getOrigScale(go)
        local rec = origScales[go]
        if rec == nil then
            local s = go.transform.localScale
            rec = { x = s.x, y = s.y, z = s.z }
            origScales[go] = rec
        end
        return rec
    end

    -- ===== 入场 =====

    function Anim.fadeIn(go, duration, delay)
        if go == nil then return end
        local cg = getCanvasGroup(go)
        cg.alpha = 0
        cg.blocksRaycasts = false   -- 延迟 / 淡入期间不接收点击
        addTween({
            target = go, channel = "alpha",
            duration = duration or 0.3, delay = delay, ease = Ease.outQuad,
            apply = function(v) cg.alpha = v end,
            onComplete = function()
                cg.alpha = 1
                cg.blocksRaycasts = true
            end,
        })
    end

    function Anim.slideIn(go, dx, dy, duration, delay)
        if go == nil then return end
        local rec = getOrigPos(go)
        if rec == nil then return end
        rec.rect.anchoredPosition = UnityEngine.Vector2(rec.x + dx, rec.y + dy)
        addTween({
            target = go, channel = "pos",
            duration = duration or 0.35, delay = delay, ease = Ease.outCubic,
            apply = function(v)
                rec.rect.anchoredPosition = UnityEngine.Vector2(rec.x + dx * (1 - v), rec.y + dy * (1 - v))
            end,
        })
    end

    function Anim.scaleIn(go, duration, delay)
        if go == nil then return end
        local tr = go.transform
        local cg = getCanvasGroup(go)
        local base = getOrigScale(go)
        cg.alpha = 0
        cg.blocksRaycasts = false
        tr.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(base.x * 0.7, base.y * 0.7, base.z)
        local d = duration or 0.3
        addTween({
            target = go, channel = "scale",
            duration = d, delay = delay, ease = Ease.outBack,
            apply = function(v)
                local k = 0.7 + 0.3 * v
                tr.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(base.x * k, base.y * k, base.z)
            end,
        })
        addTween({
            target = go, channel = "alpha",
            duration = d * 0.5, delay = delay, ease = Ease.outQuad,
            apply = function(v) cg.alpha = v end,
            onComplete = function()
                cg.alpha = 1
                cg.blocksRaycasts = true
            end,
        })
    end

    -- ===== 退场 =====

    function Anim.fadeOutThen(go, duration, onDone)
        if go == nil then
            if onDone then onDone() end   -- 节点缺失也走回调，业务时序不断
            return
        end
        local cg = getCanvasGroup(go)
        addTween({
            target = go, channel = "alpha",
            duration = duration or 0.2, ease = Ease.outQuad,
            apply = function(v) cg.alpha = 1 - v end,
            onComplete = function()
                cg.alpha = 1               -- 复位，下次显示从干净状态开始
                if onDone then onDone() end -- 播完才轮到 SetActive(false)
            end,
        })
    end

    -- ===== 反馈 =====

    function Anim.pop(go, amount)
        if go == nil then return end
        local tr = go.transform
        local base = getOrigScale(go)
        local k = amount or 0.12
        addTween({
            target = go, channel = "scale",
            duration = 0.1, ease = Ease.outQuad,
            apply = function(v)
                local s = 1 + k * v
                tr.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(base.x * s, base.y * s, base.z)
            end,
            onComplete = function()
                addTween({
                    target = go, channel = "scale",
                    duration = 0.18, ease = Ease.outBack,
                    apply = function(v)
                        local s = 1 + k * (1 - v)
                        tr.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(base.x * s, base.y * s, base.z)
                    end,
                })
            end,
        })
    end

    function Anim.shake(go)
        if go == nil then return end
        local rec = getOrigPos(go)
        if rec == nil then return end
        addTween({
            target = go, channel = "pos",
            duration = 0.4, ease = Ease.linear,
            apply = function(v)
                rec.rect.anchoredPosition = UnityEngine.Vector2(
                    rec.x + 8 * math.sin(v * math.pi * 6) * (1 - v),   -- 衰减正弦，v=1 严格回原位
                    rec.y)
            end,
        })
    end

    function Anim.flash(go)
        if go == nil then return end
        local cg = getCanvasGroup(go)
        addTween({
            target = go, channel = "alpha",
            duration = 0.5, ease = Ease.linear,
            apply = function(v) cg.alpha = 0.55 + 0.45 * math.cos(v * math.pi * 4) end,
            onComplete = function() cg.alpha = 1 end,
        })
    end

    -- ===== 循环强调（stopWhen 返回 true 时复位并自止）=====

    function Anim.pulseScale(go, stopWhen, period, amplitude, delay)
        if go == nil then return end
        local tr = go.transform
        local base = getOrigScale(go)
        period = period or 1.2
        amplitude = amplitude or 0.04
        addTween({
            target = go, channel = "scale", delay = delay,
            loopFn = function(s)
                if stopWhen and stopWhen() then
                    tr.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(base.x, base.y, base.z)
                    return false
                end
                local k = 1 + amplitude * math.sin(s / period * 2 * math.pi)
                tr.localScale = UnityEngine.Vector3(base.x * k, base.y * k, base.z)
            end,
        })
    end

    function Anim.breatheAlpha(go, stopWhen, period, delay)
        if go == nil then return end
        local cg = getCanvasGroup(go)
        period = period or 1.2
        addTween({
            target = go, channel = "alpha", delay = delay,
            loopFn = function(s)
                if stopWhen and stopWhen() then
                    cg.alpha = 1
                    return false
                end
                cg.alpha = 0.55 + 0.45 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(s / period * 2 * math.pi))
            end,
        })
    end

    function Anim.spin(go, stopWhen, degPerSec)
        if go == nil then return end
        local tr = go.transform
        degPerSec = degPerSec or 360
        addTween({
            target = go, channel = "rotation",
            loopFn = function(s)
                if stopWhen and stopWhen() then
                    tr.localEulerAngles = UnityEngine.Vector3(0, 0, 0)
                    return false
                end
                tr.localEulerAngles = UnityEngine.Vector3(0, 0, -(s * degPerSec) % 360)
            end,
        })
    end

    -- ===== 入场配置表装配器（可选便捷入口）=====

    local entrancePresets = {
        fadeIn = function(go, e)
            Anim.fadeIn(go, e.duration, e.delay)
        end,
        scaleIn = function(go, e)
            Anim.scaleIn(go, e.duration, e.delay)
        end,
        slideInLeft = function(go, e)
            Anim.slideIn(go, e.dx or -120, e.dy or 0, e.duration, e.delay)
        end,
        slideInRight = function(go, e)
            Anim.slideIn(go, e.dx or 120, e.dy or 0, e.duration, e.delay)
        end,
        slideInTop = function(go, e)
            Anim.slideIn(go, e.dx or 0, e.dy or 120, e.duration, e.delay)
        end,
        slideInBottom = function(go, e)
            Anim.slideIn(go, e.dx or 0, e.dy or -120, e.duration, e.delay)
        end,
    }

    -- entries: { { node = "<data-u-name>", preset = "<预设名>", delay = 秒, duration = 秒, dx = 像素, dy = 像素 }, ... }
    -- resolve: function(nodeName) -> GameObject
    function Anim.playEntrance(entries, resolve)
        if entries == nil or resolve == nil then
            return
        end
        for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
            local go = resolve(e.node)
            if go == nil then
                animationLogger:warn("entrance node not found", e.node)
            else
                local play = entrancePresets[e.preset]
                if play == nil then
                    animationLogger:warn("unknown entrance preset", e.preset)
                else
                    play(go, e)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function Anim.clearAll()
        activeTweens = {}
        origPositions = {}
        origScales = {}
    end

    return Anim
end

return Animation
